entries.work: Grouped hotel-review patterns into guest profiles and compared the service attributes each profile valued.
entries.output: Review features, ten reported profiles and recommendations for hotel service planning.

entries.work: Modeled how young consumers trade EV range, charging time and design against price to identify buyer groups and product priorities.
entries.output: Two preference groups and feature valuations to support product-positioning decisions.

entries.work: Co-authored research on how product arguments and creator appeal relate to purchase intention among Generation Z consumers.
entries.output: An interpretation of persuasion cues and purchase intention, published in a Springer chapter.

entries.work: Co-authored a study of how students’ nutrition knowledge and physical activity relate to their dietary choices.
entries.output: Knowledge-domain comparisons and an adjusted diet-quality model for the student sample.

entries.work: Compared policy packages and respondent interactions to examine how restrictions and support measures are valued.
entries.output: Monthly willingness-to-pay estimates and subgroup considerations for transition planning.

entries.work: Mapped review sentences to service attributes with Sentence-BERT and compared separate penalty and reward coefficients.
entries.output: A service-priority framework distinguishing failure prevention from improvement opportunities.

entries.work: Translated hotel-review themes into value dimensions and practical service hypotheses.
entries.output: Three conceptual guest-value profiles and questions for a future measurement study.

entries.work: Interpreted the split-sample measurement and structural model linking content, expectations and brand equity with engagement.
entries.output: An engagement-to-retention framework with reported explanatory statistics.

entries.work: Compared menu-order conditions across two studies and interpreted the trade-off between intended intake and premium-tier choice.
entries.output: Condition comparisons, an ordinal-choice result and a perceived-value mediation finding.

entries.work: Separated individual and collective ownership and mapped their proposed links with commitment and cooperation.
entries.output: A conceptual specification for a future organizational study; no fitted effects are claimed.

entries.work: Examined experience-value pathways through workshop attitude to participation intention.
entries.output: A reported mediation pathway and service-design questions for beginner learning support.
